translation: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 651 here, indra, is thy soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: run hither, come and drink thereof!

translation: Strong-rayed! adored with earnest hymns! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Akhandala!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 652 strong-rayed! adored with earnest hymns! this juice is shed for thy delight: thou art invoked, akhandala!

translation: To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Sringavrish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 653 to kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of sringavrish! to thee, to him have i addressed my thought.

translation: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand, Manifold and nutritious spoil!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 654 indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand, manifold and nutritious spoil!

translation: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth. Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 655 we know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth. mighty in measure, prompt to aid.

translation: Hero when thou wouldst give thy gifts, neither the Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful bull.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 656 hero when thou wouldst give thy gifts, neither the gods nor mortal men restrain thee like a fearful bull.

translation: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 657 hero, the soma being shed, i pour the juice for thee to drink: sate thee and finish thy carouse!

translation: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemy of prayer!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 658 let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: love not the enemy of prayer!

translation: Here let them cheer thee well supplied with milk to great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 659 here let them cheer thee well supplied with milk to great munificence: drink as the wild bull drinks the lake!

translation: Here is the Soma juice expressed: O Vasu, drink till thou art full! Undaunted God, we give it thee!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 660 here is the soma juice expressed: o vasu, drink till thou art full! undaunted god, we give it thee!

translation: Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool, 'Tis like a courser bathed in streams.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 661 washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool, 'tis like a courser bathed in streams.

translation: This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk. Indra, I call thee to our feast.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 662 this juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk. indra, i call thee to our feast.

translation: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 663 so, lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: drink of it, thou who lovest song!

translation: Incline thy body to the juice which suits thy godlike nature well: Thee, Soma-lover! let it cheer!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 664 incline thy body to the juice which suits thy godlike nature well: thee, soma-lover! let it cheer!

translation: O Indra, let it enter both thy flanks, enter thy head with prayer, With bounty, hero! both thine arms!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 665 o indra, let it enter both thy flanks, enter thy head with prayer, with bounty, hero! both thine arms!

translation: O Come ye hither, sit ye down; to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise,
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 666 o come ye hither, sit ye down; to indra sing ye forth your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise,

translation: Laud Indra, richest of the rich, who ruleth over noblest wealth, Beside the flowing Soma juice!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 667 laud indra, richest of the rich, who ruleth over noblest wealth, beside the flowing soma juice!

translation: May he stand near us in our need with all abundance, for our wealth: With strength may he come nigh to us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 668 may he stand near us in our need with all abundance, for our wealth: with strength may he come nigh to us!

translation: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 669 in every need, in every fray we call, as friends to succour us, indra, the mightiest of all.

translation: I call him, mighty to resist, the hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 670 i call him, mighty to resist, the hero of our ancient home, thee whom my sire invoked of old.

translation: If he will hear us, let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, With strength and riches, to our call!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 671 if he will hear us, let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, with strength and riches, to our call!

translation: When Somas flow thou makest pure, Indra, thy mind that merits laud, For gain of strength that ever grows: for great is he.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 672 when somas flow thou makest pure, indra, thy mind that merits laud, for gain of strength that ever grows: for great is he.

translation: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the waterfloods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 673 in heaven's first region, in the seat of gods, is he who brings success, most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the waterfloods.

translation: Him I invoke, to win the spoil, even mighty Indra for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a friend to aid!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 674 him i invoke, to win the spoil, even mighty indra for the fray. be thou most near to us for bliss, a friend to aid!

translation: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength. Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal, messenger of all.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 675 with this mine homage i invoke agni for you, the son of strength. dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal, messenger of all.

translation: His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast! Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, the heavenly gift of wealth to men.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 676 his two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast! then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, the heavenly gift of wealth to men.

translation: Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 677 advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the sky is seen. the mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly lady makes the light.

translation: The Sun ascending, the refulgent star, pours down his beams. together with the Dawn. O Dawn, at thine arising, and, the Sun's, may we attain the share allotted us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 678 the sun ascending, the refulgent star, pours down his beams. together with the dawn. o dawn, at thine arising, and, the sun's, may we attain the share allotted us!

translation: These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 679 these morning sacrifices call you, asvins, at the break of day. for help have i invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.

translation: Ye, heroes, have bestowed wonderful nourishment: send it to him whose songs are sweet. One-minded, both of you, drive your car down to us: drink yethe savoury Soma juice!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 680 ye, heroes, have bestowed wonderful nourishment: send it to him whose songs are sweet. one-minded, both of you, drive your car down to us: drink yethe savoury soma juice!

translation: After his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand spoils.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 681 after his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from the sage who wins a thousand spoils.

translation: In aspect he is like the Sun: he runneth forward to the lakes: Seven currents flowing to the sky.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 682 in aspect he is like the sun: he runneth forward to the lakes: seven currents flowing to the sky.

translation: He, while they purify him, stands high over all things that exist Soma, a God as Surya is.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 683 he, while they purify him, stands high over all things that exist soma, a god as surya is.

translation: By generation long ago this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining cloth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 684 by generation long ago this god, engendered for the gods, flows tawny to the straining cloth.

translation: According to primeval plan this poet hath been strengthened by, The sage as God for all the Gods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 685 according to primeval plan this poet hath been strengthened by, the sage as god for all the gods.

translation: Shedding the ancient fiuid thou art poured into the cleansing sieve: Roaring, thou hast produced the Gods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 686 shedding the ancient fiuid thou art poured into the cleansing sieve: roaring, thou hast produced the gods.

translation: Bring near us those who stand aloof: strike fear into our enemy: O Pavamana, find us wealth!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 687 bring near us those who stand aloof: strike fear into our enemy: o pavamana, find us wealth!

translation: To him the active, nobly born.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 688 to him the active, nobly born.

translation: Sing ye your songs to him, O men!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 689 sing ye your songs to him, o men!

translation: The Somas skilled in song, the waves have led the water forward, like Buffaloes speeding to the woods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 690 the somas skilled in song, the waves have led the water forward, like buffaloes speeding to the woods.

translation: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 691 with stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store of kine into the wooden vats.

translation: To Indra, Vayu. Varuna to Vishnu and the Maruts let The Soma juices flow expressed.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 692 to indra, vayu. varuna to vishnu and the maruts let the soma juices flow expressed.

translation: O Soma, for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, Sweet with the liquor of the stalk, as one who wakes, into the vat that drops with meath.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 693 o soma, for the feast of gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, sweet with the liquor of the stalk, as one who wakes, into the vat that drops with meath.

translation: Like a dear son how must be decked, the bright and shining one hath clad him in his robe. Men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their hands.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 694 like a dear son how must be decked, the bright and shining one hath clad him in his robe. men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their hands.

translation: The rapture-shedding Somas have flowed forth in our assembly, pressed. To glorify our liberal lords.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 695 the rapture-shedding somas have flowed forth in our assembly, pressed. to glorify our liberal lords.

translation: Now like a swan hemaketh all the company sing each his hymm He like steed is bathed in milk.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 696 now like a swan hemaketh all the company sing each his hymm he like steed is bathed in milk.

translation: And Trita's maidens onward urge the tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 697 and trita's maidens onward urge the tawny-coloured with the stones, indu for indra, for his drink.

translation: Herewith flow on, thou friend of Gods! Singing, thou runnest round the sieve oni every side. The streams of meath have been effused.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 698 herewith flow on, thou friend of gods! singing, thou runnest round the sieve oni every side. the streams of meath have been effused.

translation: Lovely, gold-coloured, on he flows.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 699 lovely, gold-coloured, on he flows.

translation: For him who presses, of the juice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 700 for him who presses, of the juice.

translation: Soma, as leader of the song, flow onward with thy wondrous aid. For holy lore of every sort!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 701 soma, as leader of the song, flow onward with thy wondrous aid. for holy lore of every sort!

translation: Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, Flow onward, known to all mankind! 1 O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to enhance thy might: The milch-kine run for thy behoof.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 702 do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, flow onward, known to all mankind! 1 o soma, o thou sage, these worlds stand ready to enhance thy might: the milch-kine run for thy behoof.

translation: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: Drive all our enernies away!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 703 indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: drive all our enernies away!

translation: And in thy friendship, Indu, most sublime and glorious, may we Subdue all those who war with us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 704 and in thy friendship, indu, most sublime and glorious, may we subdue all those who war with us!

translation: Those awful weapons which thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-- Guard us therewith from every foe!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 705 those awful weapons which thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-- guard us therewith from every foe!

translation: O Soma, thou art strong and bright, potent, O God, with potent sway,
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 706 o soma, thou art strong and bright, potent, o god, with potent sway,

translation: Steer-strong thy might is like a steer's, steer-strong the wood, steer-strong the juice: A steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 707 steer-strong thy might is like a steer's, steer-strong the wood, steer-strong the juice: a steer indeed, o steer, art thou.

translation: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: Unbar for us the doors to wealth!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 708 thou, indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: unbar for us the doors to wealth!

translation: For thou art strong by splendour: we, O Pavamana call on thee, The brilliant looker on the light.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 709 for thou art strong by splendour: we, o pavamana call on thee, the brilliant looker on the light.

translation: When thou art sprinkled with the streams, thou reachest, purified by men, Thy dwelling in the wooden vat.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 710 when thou art sprinkled with the streams, thou reachest, purified by men, thy dwelling in the wooden vat.

translation: Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength. O Indu, come thou hitherward!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 711 do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength. o indu, come thou hitherward!

translation: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o'er The limit of the cleansing sieve.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 712 we seek to win thy friendly love, even pavamana's flowing o'er the limit of the cleansing sieve.

translation: With those same waves which in their stream o'erflow the purifying sieve, Soma, be gracious unto us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 713 with those same waves which in their stream o'erflow the purifying sieve, soma, be gracious unto us!

translation: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides-for thou canst- Riches and food with hero sons!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 714 o soma, being purified, bring us from all sides-for thou canst- riches and food with hero sons!

translation: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 715 agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, hotar, possessor of all wealth.

translation: With constant calls they invocate Agni, Agni, Lord of the house, Oblation-bearer, much-beloved
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 716 with constant calls they invocate agni, agni, lord of the house, oblation-bearer, much-beloved

translation: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who trims the Sacred grass: Thou art our Hotar, meet for praise!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 717 bring the gods hither, agni, born for him who trims the sacred grass: thou art our hotar, meet for praise!

translation: Mitra and Varuna we call to drink the draught of Soma juice, Those born endowed with holy strength.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 718 mitra and varuna we call to drink the draught of soma juice, those born endowed with holy strength.

translation: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuna.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 719 those who by law uphold the law, lords of the shining light of law, mitra i call, and varuna.

translation: Let Varuna be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids, Both make us rich exceedingly!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 720 let varuna be our chief defence, let mitra guard us with all aids, both make us rich exceedingly!

translation: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 721 indra the singers with high praise, indra reciters with their lauds, indra the choirs have glorified.

translation: Indra is close to his two bays, with chariot ready at his word, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 722 indra is close to his two bays, with chariot ready at his word, indra the golden, thunder-armed.

translation: Help us in battles Indra, in battles where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful one!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 723 help us in battles indra, in battles where thousand spoils are gained, with awful aids, o awful one!

translation: Indra raised up the son aloft in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 724 indra raised up the son aloft in heaven, that he may see afar: he burst the mountain for the kine.

translation: To Indra and to Agni we bring reverence high and holy hymn, And, craving help, soft words with prayer.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 725 to indra and to agni we bring reverence high and holy hymn, and, craving help, soft words with prayer.

translation: For all these holy singers thus implore these twain to succour them, And priests that they may win them strength.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 726 for all these holy singers thus implore these twain to succour them, and priests that they may win them strength.

translation: Eager to laud you, we with songs invoke you, bearing sacred food, Fain for success in sacrifice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 727 eager to laud you, we with songs invoke you, bearing sacred food, fain for success in sacrifice.

translation: Flow onward, mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the Marut's Lord, Winning all riches with thy power!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 728 flow onward, mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the marut's lord, winning all riches with thy power!

translation: I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, strong, Sustainer, looker on the light!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 729 i send thee forth to battle from the press, o pavamana, strong, sustainer, looker on the light!

translation: Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawnycoloured, with thy stream: Incite to battle thine ally!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 730 acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawnycoloured, with thy stream: incite to battle thine ally!

translation: A Red Bull bellowing to the kine, thou goest, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder. A shout is heard like Indra's in the battle: thou flowest on, sending this voice before thee.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 731 a red bull bellowing to the kine, thou goest, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder. a shout is heard like indra's in the battle: thou flowest on, sending this voice before thee.

translation: Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet juices, urging the meathrich plant thou goest onward. Making loud clamour, Soma Pavamana, thou flowest when thou art effused for Indra.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 732 swelling with milk, abounding in sweet juices, urging the meathrich plant thou goest onward. making loud clamour, soma pavamana, thou flowest when thou art effused for indra.

translation: So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, turning the weapon of the water's holder! Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine. O Soma!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 733 so flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, turning the weapon of the water's holder! flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine. o soma!

translation: That we may win us wealth and power we poets verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 734 that we may win us wealth and power we poets verily, call on thee: in war men call on thee, indra, the hero's lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee

translation: As such, O wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds, ever to be the conqueror's strength!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 735 as such, o wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, caster of the stone! pour on us boldly, indra, kine and chariot-steeds, ever to be the conqueror's strength!

translation: To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts, as we I we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 736 to you will i sing indra's praise who gives good gifts, as we i we know; the praise of maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

translation: As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain fiow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 737 as with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. as from a mountain fiow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.

translation: O Thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: So, Indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto our dwelling-place!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 738 o thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: so, indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto our dwelling-place!

translation: Lord of bay steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: thee we seek. Here the disposers wait on thee. Thy glories, meet for praise! are highest by the juice, O Indra, lover of the song.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 739 lord of bay steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: thee we seek. here the disposers wait on thee. thy glories, meet for praise! are highest by the juice, o indra, lover of the song.

translation: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 740 flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, slaying the wicked, dear to gods!

translation: Killing the foeman and his hate, and daily winning spoil and strength, Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 741 killing the foeman and his hate, and daily winning spoil and strength, gainer art thou of steeds and kine.

translation: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, Falcon-like resting in thine home!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 742 red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, falcon-like resting in thine home!

translation: As Pashan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure. He, Lord of all the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 743 as pashan, fortune, bhaga, comes this soma while they make him pure. he, lord of all the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.

translation: The dear cows sang in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink. The drops as they are purified, the Soma juices, make the paths.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 744 the dear cows sang in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink. the drops as they are purified, the soma juices, make the paths.

translation: O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed, Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 745 o pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed, which the five tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence!

translation: Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the furtherer of days, of mornings, and of heaven. Breath of the rivers, he hath roared into the jars, and with the help of sages entered Indra's heart.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 746 far-seeing soma flows, the steer, the lord of hymns, the furtherer of days, of mornings, and of heaven. breath of the rivers, he hath roared into the jars, and with the help of sages entered indra's heart.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 836 both kings who never injure aught have come to their sublimest home, the thousand-pillared, firmly based.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 838 armed with the bones of dead dadhyach, indra with unresisted. might the nine-and-ninety vritras slew.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 839 he, searching for the horse's head that in the mountains lay concealed, found it in saryandvdn lake.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 840 then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative steer. there in the mansion of the moon.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 841 as rain from out the cloud, for you, indra and agni, from my thought this noblest praise hath been produced.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 842 indra and agni, listen to the singer's call: accept his songs. fulfil, ye mighty lords, his prayers!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 843 give us not up to indigence, ye heroes, indra, agni, nor to slander and reproach of men!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 844 gold-hued! as one who giveth strength flow on for gods to drink, a draught for vayu and the marut host!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 845 the steer shines brightly with the gods, dear sage in his appointed home. even pavamana unbeguiled.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 846 o pavamana, sent by prayer, roaring about thy dwelling-place, ascend to vayu as law bids!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 847 o soma, indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. many fiends follow me; help me, thou tawny-hued: pass on beyond these barriers!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 849 active, while being purified, he hath assailed all enemies: they deck the sage with holy hymns.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 850 the red hath mounted to his shrine; strong indra hath approached the juice: in his firm dwelling let him rest!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 851 o indu, soma, send us now great opulence from every side: pour on us treasures thousandfold!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 852 drink soma, indra lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser, directed by the presser's arms bath pressed it.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 853 so let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, o lord of bays, thou slayest vritras, delight thee, indra, lord of princely treasuresl

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 854 mark closely, maghavan, the word i utter, this eulogy recited by vasislitha: accept the prayers i offer at thy banquet!

translation: Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 855 heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship indra who wins the victory in all encounters, for power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 856 the holy sages form a ring, to view and sing unto the ram. inciters, very brilliant, from all deceit, are with your chariters nigh to hear.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 857 bards joined in song to indra so that he might drink the soma juice. the lord of light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 858 he who as sovran lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, the vritra-slayer, vanquisher of all fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 859 honour that indra, puruhanman! for his aid, him in whose hand of old the fair sustaining bolt of thunder, mighty like the god, like surya, was deposited!

translation: The Sage of heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands, with roars, Gives us delightful powers of life.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 860 the sage of heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands, with roars, gives us delightful powers of life.

translation: He, the bright son, when born, illumed his parents who had sprung to life, Great Son, great strengtheners of Law.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 861 he, the bright son, when born, illumed his parents who had sprung to life, great son, great strengtheners of law.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 862 on, onward to a glorious home, free from all guile and dear to. men, flow with enjoyment to our praise!

translation: For, verily, Pavamana, thou, divine! endued with brightest splendour, calling all Creatures to immortality.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 863 for, verily, pavamana, thou, divine! endued with brightest splendour, calling all creatures to immortality.

translation: With whom Dadhyach Navagva opened fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrita in the felicity of Gods.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 864 with whom dadhyach navagva opened fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, by whom they won the fame of lovely amrita in the felicity of gods.

translation: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Roaring, while purified, before the voice of song.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 865 soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, roaring, while purified, before the voice of song.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 866 with prayers they cleanse the mighty steed, sporting in wood, above the fleece: our hymns, intoned, have praised him of the triple height.

translation: He hath been hastened to the jars, bountiful, like an eager horse, And, lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 867 he hath been hastened to the jars, bountiful, like an eager horse, and, lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 868 father of holy hymns, soma flows onward, the father of the earth, father of heaven. father of agni, surya's generator, the father who begat indra and vishnu.

translation: Brahman of Gods, the leader of the poets, Rishi of sages, chief of savage creatures, Falcon amid the vultures, axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 869 brahman of gods, the leader of the poets, rishi of sages, chief of savage creatures, falcon amid the vultures, axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes soma singing.

translation: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises Beholding these inferior powers, the hero, well knowing, takes his stand among the cattle.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 870 he, soma pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises beholding these inferior powers, the hero, well knowing, takes his stand among the cattle.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 871 hither, for powerful kinship, i call agni, him who prospers you, most frequent at our solemn rites.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 872 that through this famed one's power he may stand by us, even as tvasbtar comes unto the forms that must be shaped.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 873 this agni is the lord supreme above all glories' mid the gods: may he come nigh to us with strength.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 874 this poured libation, indra drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent! streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy law.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 875 when, indra, thou dost guide thy bays, there is no better charioteer: none hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o'ertaken thee.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 876 sing glory now to indra, say to him your solemn eulogies! the drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his noblest might!

translation: Indra, be pleased: drive forward, hero, striker of thy bays! Fair, like a sage, delighting in the meath, drink of the juice for rapturous joy.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 877 indra, be pleased: drive forward, hero, striker of thy bays! fair, like a sage, delighting in the meath, drink of the juice for rapturous joy.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 878 o indra, fill thy belly anew with meath that seems to flow from heaven. the sweet-voiced raptures of this juice have come, as 'twere to heaven. to thee.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 880 winner of gold and gear and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, indu! 'mid the worlds of life! rich in brave men art thou, soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with song.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 881 o soma, thou beholdest men from every side: o pavamana, steer, thou wanderest through these. pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 882 thou passest to these worlds as sovran lord thereof, o indu, harnessing thy tawny well-winged mares. may they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: o soma, let the folk abide in thy decree!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 883 the streams of pavamana, thine, finder of all i have been effused, even as surya's rays of light.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 884 making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form, soma, thou swellest like a sea.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 885 shown forth thou sendest out thy voice, o pavamana, with a roar. like surya, god, as law commands.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 886 hitherward have the somas streamed, the drops while they are purified: when blent, in waters they are raised.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 887 the milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: they come to indra, being cleansed.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 888 o soma pavamana, thou flowest as indra's gladdener: the men have seized and lead thee forth.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 889 thou, indu, when, expressed by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art ready for indra's high decree.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 890 victorious, to be hailed with joy, o soma, flow delighting men, as the supporter of mankind!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 891 flow on, best vritra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds, pure, purifying, wonderful

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 892 pure, purifying, is he called, soma effused and full of sweets, slayer of sinners, dear to gods.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 893 the sage hath robed him in the sheep's wool for the banquet of the gods, subduing all our enemies.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 894 for he, as pavamana, sends thousandfold riches in the shape of cattle to the worshippers.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 895 thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts: as such, o soma, find us fame!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 896 pour on us lofty glory, send sure riches to our liberal lords: bring food to those who sing thy praise!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 897 as thou art cleansed, o wondrous steed, o soma, thou hast entered, like a pious king, into the songs,

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 898 he, soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made bright with hands, is resting in the press.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 899 disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest. soma to the sieve, lending the laud heroic strength.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 900 pour on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment! and, soma, all felicities!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 901 as thine, o indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from, the juice, seat thee on the dear sacred grass!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 902 and, finding for us steeds and kine, o soma, with thy juice flow on through days that fly most rapidly!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 903 as one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and slays the enemy, thus, vanquisher of thousands! flow!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 904 thou, indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, hast settled in the cleansing sieve.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 905 so flow thou onward through the fleece, for indra flow to be his drink, seating thee in the shrine of law!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 906 as giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, o soma, for the angirasas!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 907 thy glories are, like lightnings from the rainy cloud, visible, agni, like the comings of the dawns, when, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 908 when, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, soon piercing through thy food according to thy will, the hosts, who ne'er decayest, eager to consume, like men on chariots, agni! strive on every side.

translation: Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, waker of wisdom, chief controller of the thought- Thee, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect priest of the holy offering, great and small, alike.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 909 agni, the hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, waker of wisdom, chief controller of the thought- thee, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect priest of the holy offering, great and small, alike.

translation: Even far and wide, O Varuna and Mitra, doth your help extend: May I obtain your kind good-will!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 910 even far and wide, o varuna and mitra, doth your help extend: may i obtain your kind good-will!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 911 true gods, may we completely gain food and a dwelling place from you: ye mitras, may we be your own!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 912 guard us, ye mitras, with your guards, save us, ye skilled to save: may we subdue the dasyus by ourselves!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 913 arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest indra, having drunk the soma which the press had shed.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 914 indra, both world gave place to thee as thou wast fighting, when thou wast the slayer of the dasyu hosts.

translation: From Indra, have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, strengthening the Law.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 915 from indra, have i measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, delicate, strengthening the law.

translation: Indra and Agni, these our songs of praise have sounded forth to you: Ye who bring blessings! drink the juice
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 916 indra and agni, these our songs of praise have sounded forth to you: ye who bring blessings! drink the juice

translation: Come, Indra, Agni, with those teams, desired of many, which ye have, O heroes, for the worshipper
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 917 come, indra, agni, with those teams, desired of many, which ye have, o heroes, for the worshipper

translation: With those to his libation poured, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, come: Come ye to drink the Soma-juice!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 918 with those to his libation poured, ye heroes, indra, agni, come: come ye to drink the soma-juice!

translation: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the reservoirs, Resting in wooden vats thy home!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 919 soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the reservoirs, resting in wooden vats thy home!

translation: Let water winning Somas flow to Indra, Vayu, Varuna, To Vishnu and Marut host!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 920 let water winning somas flow to indra, vayu, varuna, to vishnu and marut host!

translation: Soma, bestowing food upon our progeny, from every side Pour on us riches thousandfold.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 921 soma, bestowing food upon our progeny, from every side pour on us riches thousandfold.

translation: Pressed out by pressers Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, Goes even as with a mare in tawny-coloured stream, goes in a sweetly-sounding stream.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 922 pressed out by pressers soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, goes even as with a mare in tawny-coloured stream, goes in a sweetly-sounding stream.

translation: Down to the water Soma, rich in kine, bath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. They have approached the mixing-vessels as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 923 down to the water soma, rich in kine, bath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. they have approached the mixing-vessels as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.

translation: O Purifying Soma, bring to us the wondrous treasure, meet. For lauds, that is in earth and heaven!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 924 o purifying soma, bring to us the wondrous treasure, meet. for lauds, that is in earth and heaven!

translation: Cleansing the lives of men, thou, Steer, bellowing on the sacred grass, Gold-hued, hast settled in thy home.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1288 thou pavamana, didst beget the sun with might, and rain in the supporting sky, hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1291 so flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast immortal dwelling-place!

searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1728 may the stone bring thee as it speaks, the soma-stone with ringing voice! ye by command of yonder dyaus, god bright by day! have gone to heaven.

translation: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1729 for indra flow most rich in sweets, o soma, bringing him delight!

translation: Bright, meditating sacred song, these juices have sent Vayu forth.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1730 bright, meditating sacred song, these juices have sent vayu forth.

translation: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots speeding in the race.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1731 they were sent forth to feast the gods, like chariots speeding in the race.

translation: Agni I deem our Hotar priest, munificent wealth-giver, Son of Strength, who knoweth all that is even as the Sage who knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, he when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longs for it as it grows bright.

translation: We, sacrificing, call on the best worshipper thee eldest of Angirasas, singer! with hyrnns, thee, brilliant one! with singers' hymn; Thee, wandering round, as 'twere the sky, thee who art Hotar-priest of men, whom, Bull with hair of flame, the people must observe, tile people that he speed them on.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1733 we, sacrificing, call on the best worshipper thee eldest of angirasas, singer! with hyrnns, thee, brilliant one! with singers' hymn; thee, wandering round, as 'twere the sky, thee who art hotar-priest of men, whom, bull with hair of flame, the people must observe, tile people that he speed them on.

translation: He with his blazing Power refulgent far and wide, he verily it iswho conquers demon foes, conquers the demons like an axe: At whose close touch things solid partg and what is stable yields he keeps his ground and flinches not,like trees. Subduing all from the skilled archer flinches not.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1734 he with his blazing power refulgent far and wide, he verily it iswho conquers demon foes, conquers the demons like an axe: at whose close touch things solid partg and what is stable yields he keeps his ground and flinches not,like trees. subduing all from the skilled archer flinches not.

translation: O Agni, strength and fame are thine: thy fires blaze forth on high, O thou refulgent God! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper with power, the wealth that merits laud.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1735 o agni, strength and fame are thine: thy fires blaze forth on high, o thou refulgent god! sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper with power, the wealth that merits laud.

translation: With brilliantg purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy mothers, aidest them as son; thou joinest close the earth and heaven.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1736 with brilliantg purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. thou, visiting both thy mothers, aidest them as son; thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

translation: O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs! In thee have they heaped viands various, many formed; wealthborn, of wondrous help are they.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1737 o jatavedas, son of strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs! in thee have they heaped viands various, many formed; wealthborn, of wondrous help are they.

translation: Agni, spread forth, as ruler, over living things: give wealth, to us, immortal God! Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to beauteous Power.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1738 agni, spread forth, as ruler, over living things: give wealth, to us, immortal god! thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to beauteous power.

translation: I laud the Sage, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control. Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, thou givest wealth that wins success.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1739 i laud the sage, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control. thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, thou givest wealth that wins success.

translation: The men have set before them, for his favour, Agni, strong, visible to all, the holy. Thee, Lord divine, with ears to hear, most famous, mens' generations magnify with praise-songs.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1740 the men have set before them, for his favour, agni, strong, visible to all, the holy. thee, lord divine, with ears to hear, most famous, mens' generations magnify with praise-songs.

translation: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1741 agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

translation: Thy spark is black and crackling; kindled in due time, O bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1742 thy spark is black and crackling; kindled in due time, o bounteous, it is taken up. thou art the dear friend of the mighty mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.

translation: Him, duly coming, as their germ have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life. So, in like manner, do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1743 him, duly coming, as their germ have plants received: this agni have maternal waters brought to life. so, in like manner, do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.

translation: Agni grows bright for Indra: he shines far resplendent in the sky: He sends forth offspring like a queen.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1744 agni grows bright for indra: he shines far resplendent in the sky: he sends forth offspring like a queen.

translation: The sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches the holy verses. This Soma saith to him Who wake my dwelling in thy friendship.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1745 the sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches the holy verses. this soma saith to him who wake my dwelling in thy friendship.

translation: Agni is watchful, and the Richas love him: Agni is watchful, Sama hymns approach him. Agni is watchful, to him saith this Soma, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1746 agni is watchful, and the richas love him: agni is watchful, sama hymns approach him. agni is watchful, to him saith this soma, i rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.

translation: Praise to the friends who sit in front! to those seated together,praise I use the hundred-footed speech speech.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1747 praise to the friends who sit in front! to those seated together,praise i use the hundred-footed speech speech.

translation: I use the hundred-footed speech, I sing what hath a thousand paths, Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1748 i use the hundred-footed speech, i sing what hath a thousand paths, gayatra, trishtup, jagat hymn.

translation: Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn,the forms united and complete, Have the Gods made familiar friends.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1749 gayatra, trishtup, jagat hymn,the forms united and complete, have the gods made familiar friends.

translation: Agni, is light, light is Agni, Indra is light, light is Indra Surya is light, light is Surya.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1750 agni, is light, light is agni, indra is light, light is indra surya is light, light is surya.

translation: O Agni, turn again with strength, turn thou again with food and life: Save us again from grief and woe!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1751 o agni, turn again with strength, turn thou again with food and life: save us again from grief and woe!

translation: O Agni, turn again with wealth sprinkle thou us from everyside. With thine own all-supporting stream!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1752 o agni, turn again with wealth sprinkle thou us from everyside. with thine own all-supporting stream!

translation: If I, O Indra, were like thee, the single ruler over wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1753 if i, o indra, were like thee, the single ruler over wealth. my worshipper should be rich in kine.

translation: I should be fain, O Lord of power, to strengthen and enrich thesage, Where I the ford of herds of kine.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1754 i should be fain, o lord of power, to strengthen and enrich thesage, where i the ford of herds of kine.

translation: Thy goodness, Indra, is a cow yielding in plenty kine and steeds. To worshippers who press the juice.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1755 thy goodness, indra, is a cow yielding in plenty kine and steeds. to worshippers who press the juice.

translation: Yea, Waters, ye bring health and bliss: so help ye us to energy. That we may look on great delight!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1756 yea, waters, ye bring health and bliss: so help ye us to energy. that we may look on great delight!

translation: Give us a portion of the dew, the most auspicious that ye have, Like mothers in their longing love!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1757 give us a portion of the dew, the most auspicious that ye have, like mothers in their longing love!

translation: For you we gladly go to hirn to whose abode ye speed us on, And, Waters, give us procreant strength!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1758 for you we gladly go to hirn to whose abode ye speed us on, and, waters, give us procreant strength!

translation: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1759 may vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: may he prolong our days of life!

translation: Thou art our father, Vata, yea, thou art our brother and our friend: So give us strength that we may live!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1760 thou art our father, vata, yea, thou art our brother and our friend: so give us strength that we may live!

translation: The store of Amrit that laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home-- Give us strength that we may live!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1761 the store of amrit that laid away yonder, o vata, in thine home-- give us strength that we may live!

translation: The fleet steed wearing divers forms, the eagle bearing his golden raiment to his birthplace, Clothed in due season with the light of Surya, red, hath begot the sacrifice in person.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1762 the fleet steed wearing divers forms, the eagle bearing his golden raiment to his birthplace, clothed in due season with the light of surya, red, hath begot the sacrifice in person.

translation: Multiform seed he laid in waters, lustre which gathered on the earth and there developed. In the mid-air establishing his greatness, he cries aloud, seed of the vigorous courser.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1763 multiform seed he laid in waters, lustre which gathered on the earth and there developed. in the mid-air establishing his greatness, he cries aloud, seed of the vigorous courser.

translation: He hath, enduing thousand robes that suit him, as sacrifice upheld the light of Surya, Giver of ample gifts in hundreds, thousands, supporter of the heavens, earth's Lord and ruler.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1764 he hath, enduing thousand robes that suit him, as sacrifice upheld the light of surya, giver of ample gifts in hundreds, thousands, supporter of the heavens, earth's lord and ruler.

translation: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1765 they gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward; on thee with wings of gold, varuna's envoy, the bird that hasteneth to the home of yama.

translation: Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons: Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us..
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1766 erect, to heaven hath the gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons: clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us..

translation: When as a spark he cometh ilear the ocean, looking with vulture's eye as Law commandeth, His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the loftiest region.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1767 when as a spark he cometh ilear the ocean, looking with vulture's eye as law commandeth, his lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the loftiest region.

translation: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people. With eyes that close not, bellowing, sole hero, Indra subdued at once a hundred armies.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1768 swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people. with eyes that close not, bellowing, sole hero, indra subdued at once a hundred armies.

translation: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful victcr, bold, hard to overthrow, rouser of battle, Indra. the strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes, now, now vanquish in the combat!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1769 with him loud-roaring, ever watchful victcr, bold, hard to overthrow, rouser of battle, indra. the strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes, now, now vanquish in the combat!

translation: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering strong of arm the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well- laid arrows.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1770 he rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, indra who with his band brings hosts together, foe-conquering strong of arm the soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well- laid arrows.

translation: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen! Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1771 brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen! be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies!

translation: Conspicuous. by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kinewinner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1772 conspicuous. by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, the son of conquest, passing men and heroes, kinewinner, mount thy conquering car, o indra!

translation: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it-- Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1773 cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it-- follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this indra show your zeal and courage!

translation: Piercing with conquering strength the cow-stalls, Indra, pitiless hero with unbounded anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless--may he protect our armies in our battles!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1774 piercing with conquering strength the cow-stalls, indra, pitiless hero with unbounded anger, victor in fight, unshaken and resistless--may he protect our armies in our battles!

translation: Indra guide these! Brihaspati, and Soma, the guerdon and the sacrifice precede them; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1775 indra guide these! brihaspati, and soma, the guerdon and the sacrifice precede them; and let the banded maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish!

translation: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna the Maruts, and Adityas! Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, hightninded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1776 ours be the potent host of mighty indra, king varuna the maruts, and adityas! uplifted is the shout of gods who conquer, hightninded gods who cause the worlds to tremble.

translation: Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits, of my warring heroes! Urge on the strong steed's might, O Vyitra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1777 bristle thou up, o maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits, of my warring heroes! urge on the strong steed's might, o vyitra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward

translation: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be ther arrows of our army! May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1778 may indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be ther arrows of our army! may our brave men of war prevail in battle. ye gods, protect us in the shout of onset!

translation: That army of the foemen, O ye Maruts, which, striving in its. mighty strength, approaches, Hide ye and bury it in pathless darkness that not a man oF them may know the other!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1779 that army of the foemen, o ye maruts, which, striving in its. mighty strength, approaches, hide ye and bury it in pathless darkness that not a man of them may know the other!

translation: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies, and depart, O Agha! Attack them, set their hearts on fare with sorrows; so let our foes abide in utter darkness!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1780 bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies, and depart, o agha! attack them, set their hearts on fare with sorrows; so let our foes abide in utter darkness!

translation: Advance, O heroes, win the day, May Indra be your sure defence! Mighty and awful be your arms, that none may wound or injure you!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1781 advance, o heroes, win the day, may indra be your sure defence! mighty and awful be your arms, that none may wound or injure you!

translation: Loosed from the bowstring fly away, thou arrows sharpened by our prayer! Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one be left alive!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1782 loosed from the bowstring fly away, thou arrows sharpened by our prayer! go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one be left alive!

translation: Let ravens and strong-pinioned birds pursue them: yea, let that army be the food of vultures! Indra, let none escape, no sin-remover: behind them all let following birds be gathered!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1783 let ravens and strong-pinioned birds pursue them: yea, let that army be the food of vultures! indra, let none escape, no sin-remover: behind them all let following birds be gathered!

translation: This host of foemen Maghavan! that cometh on in warlike show-- Meet it, O Vritra-slayer, thou, Indra, and Agni, with your flames!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1784 this host of foemen maghavan! that cometh on in warlike show-- meet it, o vritra-slayer, thou, indra, and agni, with your flames!

translation: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn. Even there may Brahmanaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1785 there where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn. even there may brahmanaspati, may aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days!

translation: Drive Rakshasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vritra's jaws: O Vritra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1786 drive rakshasas and foes away, break thou in pieces vritra's jaws: o vritra-slaying indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us!

translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1787 o indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury!

translation: Strong, ever-youthful are the arms of Indra, fair unassailable, never to be vanquished: These first let him employ when need hath come on us, wherewith the Asuras' great might was overthrown.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1788 strong, ever-youthful are the arms of indra, fair unassailable, never to be vanquished: these first let him employ when need hath come on us, wherewith the asuras' great might was overthrown.

translation: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee! Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy victory may Gods be joyful!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1789 thy vital parts i cover with thine armour: with immortality king soma clothe thee! varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy victory may gods be joyful!

translation: Blind, O my foemen, shall ye be, even as headless serpents are May Indra slay each best of you when Agni's flame hath struck you down!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1790 blind, o my foemen, shall ye be, even as headless serpents are may indra slay each best of you when agni's flame hath struck you down!

translation: Whoso would kill us, whether he be a stranger foe or one of us, May all the Gods discomfit him! My nearest, closest mail is prayer, my closest armour and defence.
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1791 whoso would kill us, whether he be a stranger foe or one of us, may all the gods discomfit him! my nearest, closest mail is prayer, my closest armour and defence.

translation: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1792 like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, o indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us!

translation: Gods, may our ears hear that which is auspicious, may our eyes see that which is good, ye holy! Extolling you with still strong limbs and bodies, may we attain the age by Gods appointed!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1793 gods, may our ears hear that which is auspicious, may our eyes see that which is good, ye holy! extolling you with still strong limbs and bodies, may we attain the age by gods appointed!

translation: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra bless us, may Pushan bless us, master of all riches! May Tarkshya with uninjured fellies bless us! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour!
searchText: सामवेद मन्त्रः 1794 illustrious far and wide, may indra bless us, may pushan bless us, master of all riches! may tarkshya with uninjured fellies bless us! brihaspati bestow on us his favour! brihaspati bestow on us his favour!
